description: Engagement snapshot of a public Instagram account: followers and the 12 newest posts with likes, comments and per-post engagement rate ((likes+comments)/followers), plus averages, median likes, best post and posting frequency over those 12. Only counts, no comment text or video views. Hidden like counts give null. Unknown users 404; a failed fetch 503 (not charged). Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_carsandbids when you need Live Cars & Bids auctions from the site's public RSS feed; social_olx when you need OLX classified listings search from OLX's public listing. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
